title: EUBUCCO
description:
The EUBUCCO (EUropean BUilding stock Characteristics in a Common and Open database for 200+ million individual buildings) dataset, originally hosted at <https://eubucco.com/>.

EUBUCCO is a scientific database of individual building footprints for 200+ million buildings across the 27 European Union countries and Switzerland, together with three main attributes – building type, height and construction year – included for respectively 45%, 74%, 24% of the buildings.

EUBUCCO is composed of 50 open government datasets and OpenStreetMap that have been collected, harmonized and partly validated.

The license of the data is ODbL.
For simplicity reasons, we did not include the small parts of the dataset with different licenses (Prague and Abruzzo) which can still be downloaded from the original source as `v0_1−CZE_11−OTHER−LICENSE−CC−BY−SA.zip` for Prague and `v0_1−ITA_1−OTHER−LICENSE−CC−BY−NC.zip`.
